title: One MCP hub between agents and tools
subtitle: Agents ask the hub for tools. The hub decides which server answers, with which credentials, and records the call.
alt: Three tiers: agent harnesses call an MCP hub that provides a server registry, scoped credentials, tool policy and an audit log, which fronts individual MCP servers.
source: Hub pattern as run in the Starlight tool plane; harness list from the estate harness matrix.
